entities.title: High-score API
entities.summary: POST game, POST score and GET scores under /games/retro/samosa/api/.
guarantees: Errors are JSON { error } with 400, 404, 409, 422 or 500; the sign-in library's are { code, message } with 401 or 403
entities.compatibility: The browser sends the keys of a reign it played with its own copy of the engine. A deploy that changes the engine changes what an earlier key log replays to, so a reign in progress during a deploy may be refused.

entities.title: samosa-scores tables
entities.summary: games (issued seeds) and scores (replayed reigns) in D1.
guarantees: A score's id is the id of the seed it was played from
Scores are listed best first, ties oldest first (index scores_by_score)
No email or other personal data: a reign keeps only the name the player typed
entities.compatibility: schema.sql describes a fresh database; the live one changes only through worker/migrations/, applied by hand before merging.

entities.title: Public addresses
entities.summary: The game at /games/retro/samosa/ and its scores at /games/retro/samosa/scores/; the old /retro-games/samosa redirects.
consumers: Players' bookmarks, and links from icelander.net's games page and the repository's README
guarantees: /games/retro/samosa/scores redirects to the page with a trailing slash
Every path under /retro-games/samosa redirects with 308 to the same path under /games/retro/samosa
